title: 多层木笔匣
prompt: 题材为“多层木笔匣”。本例使用已收集的公开提示词结构，独立设计新主体与场景。采用紧凑器物陈列构图，低矮承托与主体形状呼应，突出结构空隙和可辨细节。 请明确表现该主体区别于相近题材的至少四项几何特征，并用少量相关细节丰富叙事。不同案例须有自己的轮廓、空间组织与主要结构。以暖木色、炭灰和柔黄铜为主，靠形体和层次区分材质。 保持所有角度的完整体积，避免大块空底座与平面贴片，不添加文字、品牌标识、真实人名、账号或内部路径。
shared_prompt:
You are the current coding model creating a collection of beautiful real 3D voxel dioramas. For each assigned scene produce an original executable JavaScript program. Make each composition distinct in silhouette, spatial layout, materials, focal object and secondary details. Build complete volumes that remain convincing when rotated. Do not use a stock scene generator or repeated semantic templates.

The program runs in an isolated VM on a 256 x 256 x 256 grid. Integer x,y,z coordinates are 0..255. Y is up, +Z is front. Keep all occupied cells within x,z=10..245 and y=4..245. Compose within about 160..210 cells of width/depth. Aim for 60,000..700,000 occupied voxels and no more than 1,500,000. No clipping, invalid coordinates, enormous bases, or detached accidental pieces. All visible details must be true voxels.

Available generic geometry primitives:
block(x,y,z,color): one integer voxel; color '#RRGGBB'; null erases.
box(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,color): inclusive filled box, all corner coordinates integers, either order accepted.
line(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,color): thin line, rounds sample positions.
ellipsoid(cx,cy,cz,rx,ry,rz,color): filled ellipsoid; radii strictly positive; floats allowed.
cylinder(cx,y0,cz,radius,height,color): filled vertical cylinder starting at y0.
cone(cx,y0,cz,bottomRadius,topRadius,height,color): vertical truncated cone; radius can reach zero at an end.
beam(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,radius,color): filled round beam/capsule between endpoints, floats allowed.
ring(cx,cy,cz,majorRadius,tubeRadius,color,axis='y'): filled torus, axis is the normal of its ring plane.
rng(): seeded deterministic random number [0,1).
Math, arrays, objects, loops and local functions are available. No other globals. No imports, require, DOM, network, filesystem, process, eval, external assets or async. Do not redefine the primitives. Box coordinates MUST be rounded if computed from trigonometry or division. Helpers that operate on continuous geometry accept floats and rasterize to integer voxels.

Use a limited, harmonious, purposeful palette (roughly 12..40 colors), sophisticated silhouettes, detailed structural elements, readable focal subjects, careful negative space, integrated secondary objects and clean material differentiation. Prefer layered architectural shapes, rounded/tapered organic shapes, and details with a clear purpose. A base may unify a diorama but should not dominate it. Avoid sparse generic boxes, random confetti, flat cutouts, featureless slabs and oversized empty ground. No text, logos, company names, personal names, handles or trademarks anywhere in the program, comments or geometry. Avoid unnecessary prose in code comments.

Do not investigate the workspace or read unrelated files. The entire scene brief and API are supplied here. Output the requested JSON schema with one entry per assigned scene; each code value contains complete executable JavaScript with top-level construction calls. Do not just define an uncalled build function. Do not output a fabricated render/quality score. The caller will execute and render your actual code and return failures for repair.

Use only the supplied seeded rng() for randomness. Do not use Math.random(), Date or time-dependent geometry. The saved scene code must reproduce the same voxel model on rerun.

JavaScript syntax: unary minus may not be used immediately before exponentiation. For a negative square use -(u*u), -Math.pow(u,2), or -(u**2). For a Gaussian use Math.exp(-(u*u)); never emit Math.exp(-u**2) or Math.exp(-((x-c)/r)**2).


Produce the scene programs directly. Tools are disabled for this generation call. The caller executes and visually checks your code after you return it; do not claim you ran tests.
